lines.text: Spotify doesn't pay artists per stream. At all.
lines.say: Spotify doesn't pay artists per stream. At all.

lines.text: So how did it pay the music industry more than $11 billion in 2025?
lines.say: So how did it pay the music industry more than eleven billion dollars in twenty twenty-five?

lines.text: It uses streamshare: roughly two-thirds of every music dollar goes to rights holders, split by share of all streams.
lines.say: It's called streamshare. Roughly two-thirds of every music dollar goes to rights holders, split by their share of all streams.

lines.text: Example (simplified): a $1,000,000 pool and 1% of all streams means $10,000.
lines.say: Here's a simplified example. If the pool were one million dollars and you got one percent of all streams, that's ten thousand dollars.

lines.text: But that goes to the label. With a 20% royalty deal, the artist gets $2,000.
lines.say: But that goes to the label. With a twenty percent royalty deal, the artist gets two thousand dollars.

lines.text: Since April 2024, a track also needs 1,000 streams in 12 months to earn anything.
lines.say: And since April twenty twenty-four, a track needs one thousand streams in twelve months to earn anything.

lines.text: Still, payouts grew from $5 billion in 2020 to $11 billion in 2025.
lines.say: Still, payouts grew from five billion dollars in twenty twenty to eleven billion in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: In 2025, more than 13,800 artists generated at least $100,000 in Spotify royalties, before label and other splits.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, more than thirteen thousand eight hundred artists generated at least a hundred thousand dollars in Spotify royalties, before label and other splits.

post.title: Spotify doesn't pay per stream. Here's how artists get paid
post.ig:
Spotify doesn't pay artists per stream. At all.
It pays by streamshare: roughly two-thirds of every music dollar goes to rights holders, split by share of all streams.
Spotify pays labels and publishers, who pay artists under their contracts.
Since April 2024, a track needs 1,000 streams in 12 months to earn royalties.
Spotify paid the music industry more than $11 billion in 2025.
Sources: Spotify Loud & Clear 2026, Spotify for Artists, Spotify 2025 Form 20-F.
